reason: The cited evidence only provides general background on HEAs/CCAs and notes that Mg-rich systems are poorly understood. None of the passages provide specific prior evidence that heat treatment of Mg-containing lightweight HEAs forms stable intermetallics, or that such formation improves corrosion or high-temperature oxidation behavior. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Non-equilibrium Mg-containing lightweight HEAs contain solid solutions and intermetallic compounds
